items.problem: Validate-UwpMigration FAILed with '14 row(s) still Status=copied' because the dev-agent had not flipped MIGRATION-MAPPING.md Status from the seeded 'copied' to 'done' before running the validator.
items.evidence: session-log.txt line 3353 ([FAIL] ... 14 row(s) still Status=copied); resolved in turns 33-34 by a bulk 'copied'->'done' replace, then re-run → PASS (line 3427).
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-MAPPING.md header seeded by Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 (lines 448-450): 'Do not add or remove rows during Steps 2-5; only refine the Triage label and flip the Status.' The validator check #3 also explicitly enforces 'no row stuck at Status=copied'.
items.why_no_skill_change: The workflow is prominently stated in the seeded mapping file and enforced by the validator; the agent simply ran the validator before flipping and immediately self-corrected. A capable model on re-run flips statuses as it completes files with no skill change needed.
